definitions: Relating to or denoting a subfamily of Afro-Asiatic languages that includes Hebrew, Aramaic, Arabic, and Amharic.
Relating to or denoting the peoples who speak or spoke a Semitic language, especially Jews and Arabs.
Relating to or characteristic of Semitic peoples or their cultures.
examples: Semitic languages are spoken by millions.
The region has a rich Semitic heritage.
Many Semitic cultures share similar traditions.
